not_blind_rationale: The E1146 Fig.3 clinical target, the candidate morphology table and the 5% E-to-I trajectory were all viewed before this revision was written. Rewriting the selection rule cannot remove that exposure. No output of this round may be called BLIND, prospective, or patient-generalising.

frozen_substrate_manifest.role: Fig.4 substrate of record: node field, learned E-to-E / E-to-I coefficient rows, direction classifier

shaft_aware_target_npz.role: frozen scoring contract: contact order and shaft-aware embedding center/scale/components

contact_contract.role: montage of record: 15 contacts, shaft ids, sheet positions, display order

common_detector_audit.role: frozen common absolute event detector threshold

repertoire_reference_summary.role: OOD q95 and natural-KMeans balanced-alignment q05 over the 48 archived Z/M-off reference runs

historical_repertoire_gate.role: the 2026-08-19 canary-seed repertoire verdict this round must reproduce before extending it

baseline_window_verdict.role: evidence that t_base = [500,1000] ms is low activity on the exact carry-over arm at seeds 1801-1803

historical_morphology_module.role: classify_sustained_runaway; never modified by this round

exact_fig4_carryover.definition: the frozen rev11-NLC substrate joint_04_control at E-to-E dose 1.0 and E-to-I dose 1.0, with the reference Z/M protocol activated and nothing else changed

model_ictal_v2.name: MODEL_ICTAL_ELIGIBLE_V2
model_ictal_v2.duty_rule: joint: a W_early window counts only when F_E >= threshold AND F_sheet >= threshold in the same window
model_ictal_v2.primary_verdict_is_fixed: The primary verdict uses duty 0.8, activity 0.5, bin 1.0 mm and occupancy 20 only. Sensitivities are reported to expose boundary dependence and may never be substituted for the primary rule.

repertoire_gate.name: INTERICTAL_REPERTOIRE_RETAINED
repertoire_gate.rule: conjunctive over four clauses; identical to the historical contract, reference quantiles reused without refitting
repertoire_gate.displayed_event_rule: the latest returned pre-onset event that satisfies the frozen classifier filter; the word clean is a diagnostic label, never a selection criterion

motif_reuse.name: MOTIF_REUSE_ABOVE_MATCHED_NULL
motif_reuse.gate: exploratory: observed network-level statistic must exceed the q95 of its matched null
motif_reuse.aggregation: each network carries equal weight; within-network event resampling quantifies within-network uncertainty only
motif_reuse.declared_before_scores: These counts and seeds are frozen in this file before any candidate motif-reuse score has been computed in this round.

allowed_pre_freeze_inputs: Fig.4 interictal train and reference artifacts and the frozen direction classifier
model-internal qualification, repertoire, reuse and numerical-safety metrics
parameter-neighbourhood and seed robustness of the model trajectories
log-parameter distance from the exact Fig.4 carry-over point

forbidden_pre_freeze_inputs.rationale: spec section 8: clinical ictal endpoints are evaluation endpoints, never candidate-selection variables. A producer that touches any of these before WORKPOINT_FROZEN.json exists must fail hard, not warn.
forbidden_pre_freeze_inputs.note: results/interictal_propagation_masked/** and results/spatial_modulation/propagation_geometry/** stay ALLOWED: they carry the patient's interictal timing field, which is the Fig.4 training input, not an ictal endpoint.

already_viewed: the E1146 Fig.3 clinical ictal target and its locked seizure-2 parity values
the complete 20-run calibration morphology table, including which candidate passed the historical classifier
the 2% and 5% E-to-I trajectories and the rendered 5% work-point replay
analyst_exposure.consequence: Every artifact of this round is labelled DEVELOPMENT_ONLY_RETROSPECTIVE_DISCOVERY_AUDIT. A prospective discovery claim requires a patient or sealed seizure unit that has not been opened before the work point is frozen.

claim_boundary: Development-only, retrospective, non-blind. Forbidden: blind discovery; patient generalisation; patient causal mechanism; clinical seizure reproduction; model current equated with SEEG voltage; model Hz equated with patient Hz; a representative seed treated as network-ensemble reproducibility.
